sections.A: Achilles tendon pindli ki muscles ko edi ki haddi se jorta hai. Tendinopathy load se juda dard hai, beech wale hisse mein ya edi par judne ki jagah.
sections.B: Tendon mein dard aur akdan, subah aur activity ke shuru mein zyada, thora garam hone par kam.
sections.C: Dard tendon ke beech mein hai, edi par, ya takhne ke peeche gehra; aur kya load ya joote haal mein badle.
sections.D: Dono tendons dekhein (sujan, gaanth), dabayein, aur single-leg heel raise karwayein.
sections.E: Tendon dabana, painful arc sign aur Thompson test (rupture ke liye).
sections.F: Achilles rupture (achanak pop, Thompson positive, gap) aur paratendinopathy isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Achanak pop, panjon par na uth sakna, Thompson positive ya gap: complete tear, urgent refer.
sections.H: Pehle rupture rule out. Phir tendon mein dard, subah ka akdan aur load se dard: Achilles tendinopathy.
sections.I: Pindli par soft tissue kaam aur takhne ki mobilisation.
sections.J: Dheere dheere barhta tendon load pehli line ka ilaaj hai (heel raises, eccentric ya heavy slow), phir hop aur daurna.
sections.K: Barf aur TENS optional. Lambe dard mein shockwave ek option.
sections.L: Rupture screen karein, tendinopathy ko load ka masla samjhayein, phir 12 hafte ya zyada ka loading program.
sections.M: VISA-A, hop ya heel raise mein dard, subah ka akdan aur heel raise ki ginti dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 38 saal ke runner ko edi se 4 cm upar dard hai, subah sab se zyada. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: rupture rule out, phir education, load control aur dheere dheere loading.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
